# DemoKit API

## Loading

After Registry.

## Public surface

`Add(name)`, `Count()`, `SetLimits(limits)`, `GetLimits()`.

## Secret values

`Add` refuses a secret name.

## Limits

| Limit | Default | Ceiling |
|---|---|---|
| `maxItems` | 8 | 64 |

## Error behaviour

At the caller.

## Performance

Nothing per frame.

## Embedded copies and upgrades

Kept in place.
